verdict.rationale: Paddle lets you pull account data out programmatically. Reports can be generated via API to feed accounting and BI systems, including payout reconciliation and a subscriptions report covering every subscription. Metrics are also available via API, and a full OpenAPI-described Billing API with SDK pagination allows bulk retrieval. However, nothing documents a complete account export, the formats used, or an exit path. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON bulk export), payment-method/customer data portability for migrating off Paddle, independent corroboration of export completeness.
